info.title: pinion
info.description: Lock what your legacy .NET code does today into runnable characterization tests, migrate with AI or by hand, then prove nothing changed. Offline by default - the analyze and deterministic generate paths make zero network calls, with no telemetry and no AI unless you opt in. Supports C# and VB.NET.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: Pinion — lock the current behavior of legacy .NET so you can migrate without breaking the base.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: quickstart
commands.description: Lock your riskiest behaviors in one step: analyze → scaffold a test project → characterize (offline, no AI).

options.name: --top
options.description: How many of the highest-risk untested methods to lock. [default: 10]

options.name: --test-project
options.description: An existing test project (.csproj) to host the tests. If omitted, one is scaffolded next to the code project.

options.name: --tfm
options.description: Target framework for a scaffolded test project. [default: net8.0]

options.name: --allow-side-effects
options.description: Include methods tagged io/money. WARNING: locking these EXECUTES real side effects (files, DB, network, payments). [default: False]

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Per-method test-run timeout in seconds (kills a hung/infinite-loop target). [default: 180]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would be locked and where the test project would go — write and run nothing. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print Roslyn/MSBuild diagnostics to stderr. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: The code to characterize: a .csproj (or a directory containing exactly one), or a .sln/dir with --test-project.

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Scan a codebase and produce a Migration Readiness Report.

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format for stdout. [default: Console]

options.name: --out
options.description: Also write the rendered report to this file.

options.name: --top
options.description: Show only the top N hotspots (0 = all). [default: 0]

options.name: --threshold
options.description: Risk score (0–10) at/above which an untested method is counted high-risk. [default: 3.5]

options.name: --coverage
options.description: Run the target's tests under Coverlet and include executed coverage % (slower). [default: False]

options.name: --mutation-report
options.description: Overlay per-file mutation scores in the HTML report (JSON from `prove --report-json`).

options.name: --open
options.description: Open the rendered report in the default browser (a static file — no server is started). [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite the --out file if it already exists. [default: False]

options.name: --include-refs
options.description: When the target is a single .csproj, also analyze its referenced projects (default: just the target project). [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print Roslyn/MSBuild diagnostics to stderr. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Path to a .sln, .csproj, or a directory containing one.

commands.name: seam
commands.description: Introduce test seams for ambient values (DateTime.Now, Guid.NewGuid, …) so untestable methods become lockable.

options.name: --target
options.description: Only seam methods whose name (or containing type) contains this substring.

options.name: --apply
options.description: Write the rewrites (default is preview only). Applied edits are compile-checked and reverted if the build breaks. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print diagnostics to stderr. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Path to the .sln, .csproj, or source directory to seam.

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate characterization tests that lock current behavior. Deterministic and offline by default; AI providers are opt-in.

options.name: --test-project
options.description: Test project (.csproj) to host the generated tests. Must reference the code under test, xunit, and VerifyXunit.

options.name: --target
options.description: Only characterize methods whose name/id contains this substring.

options.name: --top
options.description: When --target is omitted, characterize the top N high-risk untested methods. [default: 1]

options.name: --provider
options.description: Generator: 'deterministic' (default, offline, no AI). AI providers are opt-in: 'anthropic', 'openai', 'azure-openai' (each needs its own API key env var), plus 'heuristic' for offline pipeline testing. [default: deterministic]

options.name: --model
options.description: Model id for generation. Defaults per provider; for azure-openai this is your DEPLOYMENT name and is required. [default: ]

options.name: --base-url
options.description: Override the API base URL (a local or self-hosted endpoint, a gateway, or your Azure OpenAI resource). Defaults to the selected provider's own host. [default: ]

options.name: --max-repairs
options.description: Max compile/run repair attempts per target. [default: 3]

options.name: --max-spend
options.description: Hard ceiling on estimated API spend (USD) for the run; stops before exceeding it. [default: 5.00]

options.name: --max-targets
options.description: Safety cap on how many methods one run may characterize. [default: 25]

options.name: --allow-side-effects
options.description: Include methods tagged io/money. WARNING: running these executes real side effects (files, DB, network, payments). [default: False]

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Exclude methods whose file/name/id matches (substring or glob; repeatable). Also reads .pinionignore.

options.name: --no-send
options.description: Mark files/namespaces whose source must NEVER be sent to the AI (substring/glob; repeatable). Also reads .pinionnosend. Such methods are still locally characterizable with --provider deterministic.

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Per-method test-run timeout in seconds (kills a hung/infinite-loop target). [default: 180]

options.name: --license
options.description: License key (else PINION_LICENSE env / pinion.license file). Dormant: nothing is gated.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show exactly what would be sent to the model, in that provider's own wire format, and make no API call. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print pipeline + diagnostics to stderr. [default: False]

arguments.name: PATH
arguments.description: Path to the .sln/.csproj/dir containing the code to characterize.

commands.name: init-tests
commands.description: Scaffold a Verify-ready xUnit project to host generated characterization tests.

options.name: --out
options.description: Directory to create the test project under (default: alongside the code project).

options.name: --name
options.description: Test project name (default: <CodeProject>.CharacterizationTests).

options.name: --tfm
options.description: Target framework for the test project. [default: net8.0]

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite the test project if it already exists. [default: False]

options.name: --stdout
options.description: Print the .csproj to stdout instead of writing it. [default: False]

arguments.name: CODE_PROJECT
arguments.description: The .csproj (or a directory containing one) whose behavior you'll characterize — added as a ProjectReference.

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Re-run the locked behavior against current code and report what changed (CI gate).

options.name: --format
options.description: Output format for stdout (Console, Markdown, or Json). [default: Console]

options.name: --out
options.description: Also write the rendered report to this file.

options.name: --subdir
options.description: Folder under the test project holding the generated tests/snapshots. [default: PinionCharacterization]

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Hard timeout (seconds) for the whole test run. [default: 600]

options.name: --open
options.description: Open the rendered report in the default browser (a static file — no server is started). [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite the --out file if it already exists. [default: False]

options.name: --since
options.description: Verify only behaviors a change could affect: methods in files changed since this git ref (e.g. main, HEAD~1) plus their callers. Scopes a PR check to what it touched (C#).

options.name: --source
options.description: The code under test (.sln/.csproj/dir) for --since blast-radius analysis. Defaults to the test project's ProjectReference.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print diagnostics to stderr. [default: False]

arguments.name: TEST_PROJECT
arguments.description: The test project (.csproj) hosting the generated characterization tests + golden masters.

commands.name: accept
commands.description: Re-baseline intended behavior changes: promote the current output to the golden master for matching methods.

options.name: --name
options.description: Re-baseline only changed behaviors whose name contains this substring (e.g. a class or method name).

options.name: --all
options.description: Re-baseline EVERY changed behavior. Use only after reviewing the verify diff — this accepts all current output as correct. [default: False]

options.name: --subdir
options.description: Folder under the test project holding the generated tests/snapshots. [default: PinionCharacterization]

options.name: --timeout
options.description: Hard timeout (seconds) for the test run. [default: 600]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print diagnostics to stderr. [default: False]

arguments.name: TEST_PROJECT
arguments.description: The test project (.csproj) hosting the characterization tests + golden masters.

commands.name: prove
commands.description: Mutation-test the generated tests (needs dotnet-stryker) and report the regression-catching score.

options.name: --test-project
options.description: Test project (.csproj) whose tests should be mutation-tested.

options.name: --license
options.description: License key (else PINION_LICENSE / pinion.license file). Dormant: nothing is gated.

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Print diagnostics to stderr. [default: False]

options.name: --report-json
options.description: Also write the score report as JSON (feed it to `analyze --format html --mutation-report`).

commands.name: ci
commands.description: Scaffold a CI workflow that gates PRs on the characterization tests (GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps).

options.name: --provider
options.description: Which CI system to scaffold for. [default: GitHub]

options.name: --test-project
options.description: Characterization test project (.csproj) the gate runs. Omit to emit a placeholder to edit.

options.name: --solution
options.description: Solution/project for the optional analyze step. Omit to emit a placeholder.

options.name: --out
options.description: Where to write the workflow (default: the provider's conventional path).

options.name: --with-prove
options.description: Include the mutation-score step (needs dotnet-stryker). [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite the workflow file if it already exists. [default: False]

options.name: --stdout
options.description: Print the workflow to stdout instead of writing a file. [default: False]

commands.name: license
commands.description: Inspect the current license / show this machine's id.

commands.name: activate
commands.description: Install a license key on this machine (offline — nothing is sent anywhere).

options.name: --local
options.description: Install to ./pinion.license (this project only) instead of ~/.pinion/license (all projects). [default: False]

arguments.name: KEY
arguments.description: Your license key (paste it from your account page or your purchase/renewal email).

commands.name: verify
commands.description: Check whether a valid license is present.

options.name: --license
options.description: License key (else PINION_LICENSE / pinion.license file is used).

commands.name: machine-id
commands.description: Print this machine's fingerprint (give it to the vendor for a node-locked license).
